description: This file defines the 'Relations' class for managing item relationships in the Notesnook project, including methods for adding, retrieving, caching, and removing relations, as well as related helper functions and classes.

classes.name: Relations
classes.description: Manages item relations including creation, retrieval, cache building, and deletion.

classes.name: RelationsArray
classes.description: Provides query and manipulation capabilities for relations associated with a specific item reference.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the relations collection, potentially building cache.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new relation between two item references.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns a RelationsArray for relations originating from a given item reference.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns a RelationsArray for relations pointing to a given item reference.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds in-memory caches of relations for quick access.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a relation between two item references and publishes an event.

methods.name: unlinkOfType
methods.description: Unlinks all relations of a specific type, optionally filtered by IDs, and publishes events.
